clauses.text: The navigation lists 今日, 目的と現状, プロジェクトと関係者 and 情報と関係 in that order; the two Graph screens mount only when the host reports Graph v2 and otherwise show the migration commands with the screen name; web:serve prints both screen URLs.

The host serves the /api/graph read and correction routes for its own data directory; a non-loopback Host is refused; a correction requires the launch token and the same origin, checked by the host and again inside the Graph module, and nothing is written when either is missing.

プロジェクトと関係者 lists projects with name, status, goal, 関係者 counts and validity, and a project detail with goal, status, decision principles and every participation (person, participates_in or accountable_for shown as 参加 or 責任, free-text role, validity, provenance kind in plain Japanese); the copy says 関係者, never access rights, and shows no RACI type.

The owner can add a 関係者 (participates_in or accountable_for with optional role and start date), correct role and context, end a participation with an end date defaulting to today, and correct a project's name, goal and status; nothing is deleted.

情報と関係 searches by name or alias filtered by type and as-of date, and an entity detail shows type, name, aliases, summary, validity and outgoing and incoming relations with meaning, role, validity, provenance kind and a resolved local source (extracted candidate, onboarding run candidate or correction) or the raw source id marked 未解決; a counterpart opens its own record.

Every correction requires a one-line reason, sends the digest of the record shown and only the fields the owner changed; a 409 shows the current values, keeps the draft and bases the next save on the current record; a save shows the read-back values and that MCP search, get_context and resolve_entity use them next.
The ontology panel is read-only and lists relation kinds with from and to types, meaning, count and active count, and entity types with counts; there is no change proposal.

Graph v1 is shown as migration required with both commands, a missing data set with how to start, a read failure with the reason and a retry, and unreadable reference or history lines apart from the readable records; empty is shown only when absence is confirmed; ids and digests appear only inside the details disclosure.
The new parts take colors, fonts, radii and spacing only from --bb-* tokens defined in ui/brainbase-tokens.css and do not scroll horizontally at 375px width.
